(2) PEDUNCULATED EYES: the two round expressive eyes must be mounted on SHORT VISIBLE EYESTALKS emerging from the top of the head, not flat against the head. (5) TASSEL ON BOTH ANTENNAE: the tip of EACH of the two long antennae must end in an IDENTICAL Ecuadorian tricolor tassel made of three flat ribbons stacked top to bottom: YELLOW ribbon hex FFDD00 on top, BLUE ribbon hex 003893 in the middle, RED ribbon hex CE1126 at the bottom (the tip), tied with a small visible brown leather knot at the base. Both antenna tassels must be IDENTICAL - both must be visible in the image. KEEP THE SAME: pose, cape, belt, trident, expression, lighting, background, color palette. Style: clean Pixar DreamWorks 3D semi-realistic, sharp focus, vibrant saturated colors, friendly mascot finish, anatomically respectful of Penaeus vannamei.
